scheme_name: State Talent Search Examination in Mathematics and Science for Tribal Students of Meghalaya at the Close of Upper Primary Stage (Class VIII)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a tribal student of Meghalaya belonging to the Khasi, Jaintia, Garo, Koch or Hajong communities
Student must be studying in Class VIII in any type of school in Meghalaya
Student must have secured at least 50 marks in aggregate in Mathematics and Science in Class VII
Student must continue studies in any recognized secondary school in Meghalaya
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹600 per month for twelve months each year for two years (Class IX‑X).
